place.zh: 莫贺延碛（今噶顺戈壁）

summary.zh: 玄奘在莫贺延碛迷路覆水，五天四夜滴水未进。
summary.en: Xuanzang loses his water in the Moheyan Desert and goes five days without a drop.

description.zh: 贞观四年（630）初，玄奘偷渡玉门关后进入莫贺延碛。途中失手打翻水囊，又迷失道路，五天四夜滴水未进，几乎渴死。他默念观音名号，发誓「宁可就西而死，岂归东而生」，最终由老马引至野马泉，得以生还。
description.en: In early 630, after slipping past Yumen Pass, Xuanzang entered the Moheyan Desert. He dropped his water bag and lost his way, going five days and nights without water and nearly dying of thirst. He vowed to press west rather than turn back, and was at last led by his old horse to a spring.

summary.en: After the Bedel Pass Xuanzang reaches the Great Clear Lake, a vast and wave-tossed water.

description.zh: 翻越凌山后，玄奘抵达大清池。《大唐西域记》记此湖「周千四五百里，东西长，南北狭，四面负山，众流交凑」，虽处无热之区却「洪涛浩汗，惊波汩㴔」，是当时中亚商道上的重要地标。
description.en: After crossing the Bedel Pass Xuanzang reached the Great Clear Lake. The Records of the Western Regions describes a lake over a thousand li around, long east to west and narrow north to south, ringed by mountains and fed by many streams, its waves vast and restless.

summary.en: Xuanzang studies the Abhidharma at Chinasthana, the land of the Chinese hostage.

description.zh: 至那仆底，唐言「汉封」。相传迦腻色迦王征服东土后，将汉地质子安置于此，因而得名；当地桃称「至那尔」（汉持来），梨称「至那罗阇弗呾逻」（汉王子），国人「深敬东土」。玄奘在此从调伏光法师学《对法论》《显宗论》。
description.en: Chinasthana means “Chinese fief”. Legend holds that King Kaniska settled a Chinese hostage here, and the region’s peaches and pears are still named after the Chinese prince. Xuanzang studied the Abhidharma texts here under Dharmapala’s disciple.

summary.en: Xuanzang enters Nalanda and begins five years of study under Silabhadra.

description.zh: 634 年，玄奘入那烂陀寺，礼戒贤论师为师。那烂陀是当时印度最高的佛教学府，僧徒数千，每日讲座百余所。入学年份有 633、634 诸说，本专题取 634 年，属研究推定。
description.en: In 634 Xuanzang entered Nalanda and became a disciple of Silabhadra. Nalanda was the foremost Buddhist university of India, with thousands of monks and a hundred lectures a day. The year of entry is given as 633 or 634; this atlas adopts 634.

place.zh: 那烂陀寺（今印度比哈尔邦）

summary.zh: 玄奘在那烂陀寺从戒贤学《瑜伽师地论》五年，被推为通三藏「十德」之一。
summary.en: Xuanzang studies the Yogacarabhumi under Silabhadra for five years at Nalanda.

description.zh: 玄奘在那烂陀寺师从戒贤论师，学《瑜伽师地论》，兼习《显扬圣教论》《对法论》等，前后约五年。寺中僧徒数千，戒律严整，每日百余讲座。玄奘因通晓三藏，被推为「十德」之一，为寺众讲《摄大乘论》《唯识抉择论》，并著《会宗论》《制恶见论》回应师子光、般若毱多诸说。
description.en: At Nalanda Xuanzang studied the Yogacarabhumi under Silabhadra for about five years, along with other Yogacara and Abhidharma texts. Recognised as one of the ten masters versed in the three baskets, he lectured to the assembly and composed works defending the Yogacara school against rival interpretations.

summary.zh: 戒贤论师重开讲席，为玄奘讲《瑜伽师地论》。
summary.en: Silabhadra reopens the lecture hall to teach Xuanzang the Yogacarabhumi.

description.zh: 戒贤（Śīlabhadra）时年逾百，已多年不讲。闻玄奘自支那而来，命弟子引见，叹其求法之志，遂重开讲堂，为讲《瑜伽师地论》，首尾十五月。那烂陀寺僧徒数千，讲座日百余所，玄奘自此入五年学程。开讲月日属研究推定。
description.en: Silabhadra was over a hundred and had long ceased lecturing. Hearing that Xuanzang had come from China, he reopened the hall and taught the Yogacarabhumi for fifteen months. With thousands of monks and a hundred lectures a day, Nalanda was the foremost Buddhist university of India. The month is a scholarly estimate.

summary.zh: 玄奘在那烂陀随戒贤研习《瑜伽师地论》，以此为主课。
summary.en: At Nalanda Xuanzang makes the Yogacarabhumi his principal subject.

description.zh: 《瑜伽师地论》是瑜伽行派的根本论，戒贤所传。玄奘在此论上用功最久，归国后译出百卷，成为汉传唯识学的骨干。听讲之外，兼参与寺中论议。年月经研究推定。
description.en: The Yogacarabhumi is the foundational treatise of the Yogacara school and the text Silabhadra transmitted. Xuanzang devoted most of his five years to it and later translated it in a hundred fascicles, the backbone of East Asian Consciousness-Only thought. Dates are scholarly estimates.

summary.en: Xuanzang masters the Abhidharma, Madhyamaka and logic texts alongside the Yogacarabhumi.

description.en: Beyond the Yogacarabhumi, Xuanzang studied the Abhidharma-samuccaya, the Pramana-samuccaya, the Madhyamaka-karika and the Sata-sastra, together with Buddhist logic, grammar, medicine and mathematics, earning the regard of the community. Dates are scholarly estimates.

summary.zh: 玄奘在那烂陀听《阿毗达磨顺正理论》，与《瑜伽》互相发明。
summary.en: Xuanzang studies the Nyayanusara at Nalanda alongside the Yogacarabhumi.

description.zh: 《顺正理论》为众贤论师破世亲《俱舍论》之作，义理精严。玄奘在那烂陀随戒贤门下听此论，与《瑜伽师地论》《显扬圣教论》互相发明。据《大慈恩寺三藏法师传》，五年间《瑜伽》听三遍，此论亦在讲席之列。年月经研究推定。
description.en: The Nyayanusara, by Samghabhadra, refutes Vasubandhu's Abhidharmakosa and is noted for its rigour. Xuanzang heard it expounded at Nalanda under Silabhadra's circle, setting it beside the Yogacarabhumi and the Abhidharma-samuccaya. The Biography records that he heard the Yogacarabhumi three times in five years; the month here is a scholarly estimate.

place.zh: 那烂陀寺（今印度比哈尔邦）

summary.zh: 师子光以《中》《百》破瑜伽，玄奘造《会宗论》三千颂会通，寺众叹服。
summary.en: Against Simhacandra's attack on Yogacara, Xuanzang writes three thousand verses reconciling the schools.

description.zh: 那烂陀寺师子光讲《中论》《百论》，斥《瑜伽师地论》为非，门人从之者众。玄奘以「圣人立教各随所宜」造《会宗论》三千颂，会通中观与瑜伽，戒贤与寺众称善。此事原并入「那烂陀著论」，本轮前移至此。年月经研究推定。
description.en: Simhacandra lectured on the Madhyamaka and Sata-sastras and dismissed the Yogacarabhumi, drawing many followers. Xuanzang composed three thousand verses of the Hui-zong-lun reconciling Madhyamaka and Yogacara, to the approval of Silabhadra and the community. Previously folded into the later Nalanda treatises, the episode is dated here by scholarly estimate.

place.zh: 那烂陀寺（今印度比哈尔邦）

summary.zh: 顺世外道悬义四十条于寺门，玄奘往复论难，外道辞屈。
summary.en: A Lokayata challenger posts forty theses at the gate; Xuanzang refutes him.

description.zh: 有顺世外道来那烂陀求论，书四十条义悬于寺门，约「堕负者斩首谢之」，寺僧无人敢应。玄奘请与对论，往复数番，外道辞屈请斩，玄奘止之，但令归信。年月经研究推定。
description.en: A Lokayata teacher came to Nalanda and posted forty theses at the gate, offering his head to whoever could refute them. None of the monks dared answer; Xuanzang took up the debate, and after several exchanges the challenger conceded. Xuanzang spared him and asked only that he accept the teaching. Dates are scholarly estimates.

summary.en: His studies complete, Xuanzang takes leave of Silabhadra to tour the five Indias.

description.en: After five years at Nalanda Xuanzang took leave of his master and set out on three years of pilgrimage through eastern, southern and western India, returning north in 642. The date is a scholarly estimate.

summary.zh: 玄奘巡礼王舍城，登灵鹫山，访竹林精舍与第一次结集处。
summary.en: Xuanzang visits Rajgir, climbs Vulture Peak and sees the first council site.

description.zh: 王舍城是摩揭陀国旧都，佛陀一生多处说法地。玄奘登灵鹫山（耆阇崛山），访竹林精舍、迦兰陀池，以及佛灭后第一次结集的七叶窟。《大唐西域记》卷九记此城「外郭已坏，无复遗堵」，与那烂陀仅数十里之遥。
description.en: Rajgir, the old capital of Magadha, was a favourite preaching ground of the Buddha. Xuanzang climbed Vulture Peak, visited the Bamboo Grove and the Sattapanni cave where the first council was held, and recorded that the city’s outer walls were already in ruins.

description.en: Iranaparvata lay on the Ganges near modern Monghyr in Bihar. Xuanzang studied the Vibhasa under the masters Tathagatagupta and Simhamati for several months and recorded local monastic life. Dates are scholarly estimates.

summary.en: At the eastern port of Tamralipti Xuanzang sees the sea trade and hears of the southern seas.

description.zh: 耽摩栗底（今西孟加拉邦塔姆卢克）是东印度出海口，商舶云集，与南海、僧伽罗通航。玄奘在此闻海上诸国与佛牙故事，仍决意陆行。沿途并记三摩呾吒、羯罗拏苏伐剌那诸国。年月经研究推定。
description.en: Tamralipti, near modern Tamluk in West Bengal, was the outlet of eastern India, crowded with ships bound for the southern seas and Sri Lanka. Xuanzang heard there of the maritime kingdoms and the Buddha's tooth, but chose to travel overland, recording Samatata and Karnasuvarna on the way. Dates are scholarly estimates.

description.en: Dhanyakataka, around modern Amaravati in Andhra Pradesh, was the heartland of the Andhra country where Mahayana and the schools flourished side by side, with the great stupa nearby. Xuanzang studied Mahayana treatises under two local monks. Dates are scholarly estimates.

description.en: Kanci, modern Kanchipuram, was the capital of the Dravida country and the birthplace of Dharmapala; its monastic learning was famous. Xuanzang stayed to study and recorded the customs of the southern kingdoms. Dates are scholarly estimates.

summary.en: At the southern tip of India Xuanzang hears of the Buddha's tooth in Sri Lanka.

description.en: Malakuta, around modern Madurai, faces the sea. There Xuanzang heard that Simhala — Sri Lanka — kept the Buddha's tooth with unbroken offerings; the sea route was perilous and he did not cross, though Yijing later did. Dates are scholarly estimates.

description.en: Valabhi, near modern Vala in Gujarat, was a great western port and a center of the Sammitiya school, where Yijing later studied. Xuanzang recorded its monks, monasteries and shipping before turning east for the return. Dates are scholarly estimates.

summary.zh: 玄奘经摩腊婆、邬阇衍那北归那烂陀，五印度巡礼至此结束。
summary.en: Xuanzang returns north through Malava and Ujjayini, closing his pilgrimage.

description.zh: 玄奘自伐腊毗东行，经摩腊婆、邬阇衍那、掷枳陀诸国，还归那烂陀寺。五印度巡礼前后约三年，行程数千里，所历百余国，后多载入《大唐西域记》。归期属研究推定。
description.en: From Valabhi Xuanzang went east through Malava, Ujjayini and other lands back to Nalanda. The pilgrimage had lasted about three years and covered more than a hundred kingdoms, most of them later recorded in the Records of the Western Regions. The date is a scholarly estimate.

place.zh: 那烂陀寺（今印度比哈尔邦）

summary.zh: 玄奘在那烂陀著《制恶见论》，驳般若毱多，戒日王遣使迎请。
summary.en: At Nalanda Xuanzang writes the Zhi-e-jian-lun refuting Prajnagupta, and King Harsha sends for him.

description.zh: 巡礼五印度归来，玄奘在那烂陀寺著《制恶见论》一千六百颂，驳般若毱多的《破大乘论》，并设十八日无遮论场。戒日王读到后大悦，遣使迎请玄奘，遂有曲女城大会。《会宗论》则成于游学期间（637 年，见「造《会宗论》」）。
description.en: Returning from his pilgrimage, Xuanzang composed sixteen hundred verses of the Zhi-e-jian-lun at Nalanda, refuting Prajnagupta's attack on the Mahayana, and set out the argument for eighteen days. King Harsha, delighted on reading it, sent for him — the prelude to the Kanauj assembly. The Hui-zong-lun had been written earlier, during his studies.

place.zh: 迦摩缕波（今印度阿萨姆邦）

summary.zh: 鸠摩罗王遣使迎请，玄奘东行至迦摩缕波。
summary.en: King Kumara invites Xuanzang east to Kamarupa.

description.zh: 迦摩缕波在今阿萨姆一带，「周万余里，国大都城周三十余里」，是东印度的大国。国王鸠摩罗遣使迎请玄奘，玄奘初辞，使者以毁那烂陀相胁，遂东行至其国，为王授戒。戒日王闻讯大怒，鸠摩罗王亲自送玄奘西行，二王相会于恒河之滨，同赴曲女城大会。
description.en: Kamarupa, in present-day Assam, was a great kingdom of eastern India. Its king Kumara invited Xuanzang, who at first declined; when envoys threatened to destroy Nalanda he went east and administered the precepts to the king. Harsha was furious at the news, and Kumara personally escorted Xuanzang west, the two kings meeting on the Ganges before the assembly at Kanauj.

place.zh: 曲女城（今印度卡瑙季）

summary.zh: 戒日王在曲女城设大会，玄奘为论主，十八日无人能破。
summary.en: King Harsha holds a great assembly at Kanauj where Xuanzang defeats all challengers.

description.zh: 戒日王为玄奘在曲女城设大法会，十八国国王、三千余僧、二千外道列席。玄奘为论主，立「真唯识量」，声明若有一字可破便斩首相谢。十八日无人发论，大乘众尊之为「大乘天」，小乘众尊之为「解脱天」。大会年份有 641、642、643 诸说，本专题取 643 年，属研究推定。
description.en: King Harsha convened a great assembly at Kanauj with eighteen kings, three thousand monks and two thousand non-Buddhists. Xuanzang, as defender, set forth his thesis and offered his head if anyone could refute a single word. For eighteen days no one challenged him, and he was hailed as “Mahayanadeva” and “Moksadeva”. The year is disputed (641/642/643); this atlas adopts 643.

summary.en: Harsha holds the quinquennial assembly at Prayaga, after which Xuanzang takes his leave.

description.zh: 曲女城大会后，戒日王移驾钵罗耶伽，举行五年一度的无遮大会，历时七十五日，道俗五十余万人赴会，王与群臣倾库施僧。会毕，玄奘再三请归，戒日王与鸠摩罗王挽留不成，遂赠大象、金钱与经像，遣使护送。
description.en: After Kanauj the king moved to Prayaga for the quinquennial assembly, which lasted seventy-five days and drew more than half a million people; the king and his ministers emptied the treasury in almsgiving. When it ended, Xuanzang asked leave to return and could not be dissuaded.

name.en: Loss of the Scriptures in the Indus

place.zh: 信度河（今印度河）

summary.zh: 玄奘渡信度河遇风浪，五十夹经本与花种落水。
summary.en: Xuanzang’s boat capsizes in the Indus and fifty bundles of scriptures are lost.

description.zh: 玄奘归途经呾叉始罗，渡信度河时遇风浪，船身倾覆，五十夹经本与从印度携来的花种尽数落水。他在迦毕试停留五十余日，遣人往乌仗那抄补所失经本。这是《西游记》「通天河湿经」的原型之一。
description.en: On his homeward road, crossing the Indus near Taxila, Xuanzang’s boat was caught by a squall and capsized; fifty bundles of manuscripts and the flower seeds he was carrying were lost. He stayed more than fifty days at Kapisa while messengers went to Udyana to copy the missing texts.

summary.zh: 失经后驻迦毕试五十余日，遣人往乌仗那抄补经本。
summary.en: Xuanzang stays at Kapisa for over fifty days, sending men to Udyana to copy the lost texts.

description.zh: 信度河失经后，玄奘北行至迦毕试，停留五十余日。他遣人携财物往乌仗那国抄写所失经本，同时参访城北的佛顶骨城与诸寺。迦毕试是由印度入中亚的必经之地，玄奘在此整理经像行装，再北越兴都库什山。
description.en: After losing the manuscripts in the Indus, Xuanzang went north to Kapisa and stayed more than fifty days, sending men with funds to Udyana to copy the lost texts while visiting the shrine of the Buddha’s skull-bone and the monasteries around the city, before crossing the Hindu Kush.

summary.zh: 玄奘归途抵活国，闻高昌已灭，改走天山南道。
summary.en: At Kunduz Xuanzang learns that Gaochang has fallen and changes his route.

description.zh: 玄奘北越兴都库什山，抵活国。此地原为突厥叶护可汗长子呾度设所居，其子继位后迎玄奘供养。玄奘在此闻知高昌王麴文泰已于 640 年去世、高昌已为唐所灭，遂放弃当年「归途留住高昌三年」之约，改由葱岭走天山南道归国。
description.en: Crossing the Hindu Kush northward, Xuanzang reached Kunduz, where the son of the Turkic chief received him. There he learned that King Qu Wentai of Gaochang had died in 640 and that Gaochang had been annexed by the Tang, so he gave up his promise to spend three years there and took the southern Tianshan road instead.

summary.zh: 玄奘越葱岭，经波谜罗川大龙池，冰雪千里。
summary.en: Xuanzang crosses the Pamirs past the great dragon lake, through snow and ice.

description.zh: 自活国东行，玄奘翻越葱岭，入波谜罗川。《大唐西域记》卷十二记此川「东西千余里，南北百余里，狭隘之处不逾十里」，川中有大龙池，「东西三百余里，南北五十余里，据大葱岭内，当赡部洲中，其地最高」；一路积雪弥漫，途路难涉。
description.en: East of Kunduz Xuanzang crossed the Pamirs into the high valleys. The Records describes a corridor a thousand li long and a great dragon lake three hundred li across, the highest ground in Jambudvipa, with snow lying on the passes.

place.zh: 朅盘陀（今新疆塔什库尔干）

summary.zh: 玄奘越葱岭、波谜罗川，抵朅盘陀。
summary.en: Xuanzang crosses the Pamirs and reaches Tashkurgan.

description.zh: 玄奘自活国东行，越葱岭、经波谜罗川，抵朅盘陀。《大唐西域记》记其「国大都城依峻岭」，并载建国传说：汉公主远嫁波利剌斯，途遇兵乱，避于孤峰，与日神感而生子，遂王此地，故国王自称「汉日天种」。
description.en: Traveling east from Kunduz, Xuanzang crossed the Pamirs and the Wakhan valley to Tashkurgan. The Records of the Western Regions describes its capital perched on a steep ridge and records the founding legend of a Chinese princess who took refuge on the peak and bore a son of the sun, from whom its kings claimed descent.

place.zh: 佉沙（今新疆喀什）

summary.zh: 玄奘出葱岭抵佉沙，沿塔里木盆地南缘东行。
summary.en: Xuanzang comes down from the Pamirs to Kashgar and turns east along the southern Tarim.

description.zh: 出葱岭后，玄奘抵佉沙。《大唐西域记》记此地「人性犷暴，俗多诡诈，不甚崇信佛法」，与于阗的崇佛形成对照。此后沿塔里木盆地南缘，经斫句迦至于阗。
description.en: Descending from the Pamirs, Xuanzang reached Kashgar, which the Records describes as a fierce and little-Buddhist land, in contrast with devout Khotan. From there he followed the southern edge of the Tarim basin eastward.

place.zh: 斫句迦（今新疆叶城）

summary.zh: 玄奘经斫句迦东行，记其山阜连属、佛塔众多。
summary.en: Xuanzang passes Chakuka, a stony land of many stupas, on the way to Khotan.

description.zh: 出疏勒东南行，玄奘经斫句迦。《西域记》卷十二记其「周千余里，国大都城周十余里，山阜连属，砾石弥漫」，国中有罗汉塔与数百僧徒，是塔里木盆地南缘的小国。此后沿山麓东行，抵于阗。
description.en: Southeast of Kashgar Xuanzang passed through Chakuka, which the Records describes as a thousand li around, its capital a dozen li, a land of connected hills and gravel plains with stupas of arhats and several hundred monks.

place.zh: 于阗

summary.zh: 玄奘抵于阗，上表太宗，等待归国敕命。
summary.en: Xuanzang reaches Khotan and waits for the emperor’s permission to return.

description.zh: 644 年春，玄奘沿塔里木盆地南缘抵于阗。因前路须待朝廷准许，他在此停留数月，上表报告携经归国，并应于阗王请求讲《瑜伽师地论》。
description.en: In the spring of 644 Xuanzang reached Khotan along the southern Tarim route. He stayed several months while awaiting the court’s permission, sending a memorial and teaching the Yogacarabhumi at the king’s request.

place.zh: 于阗（今新疆和田）

summary.zh: 太宗得于阗上表，敕令沿途迎送，并请玄奘速来相见。
summary.en: Taizong answers Xuanzang’s memorial from Khotan and orders an escort along the road.

description.zh: 玄奘在于阗上表后，太宗答敕曰「闻师访道殊域，今得归还，欢喜无量，可即速来，与朕相见」，并令于阗等道诸国护送，沿途供给人力鞍乘。玄奘遂整装东行。
description.en: Replying to Xuanzang’s memorial from Khotan, Emperor Taizong wrote that he rejoiced at the monk’s return and bade him come quickly to court, ordering the states along the road to escort him and supply horses and bearers.

place.zh: 尼壤（今新疆民丰一带）

summary.zh: 玄奘经尼壤，过大泽中的古精绝故地。
summary.en: Xuanzang passes Niya, a small city in a great marsh on the southern Tarim road.

description.zh: 出于阗东行，玄奘经媲摩，抵尼壤。《西域记》卷十二记「尼壤城周三四里，在大泽中」，泽地湿热难行，是塔里木南道上的要站；再东即折摩驮那故国（且末）、纳缚波故国（若羌）。
description.en: East of Khotan Xuanzang passed Pimo and reached Niya, which the Records describes as a city three or four li around set in a great marsh, a staging point on the southern Tarim road toward Charchlik and Dunhuang.

place.zh: 沙州（今甘肃敦煌）

summary.zh: 玄奘归途经沙州，再次上表太宗，太宗敕令敦煌官吏迎接。
summary.en: On his return Xuanzang reaches Shazhou and sends another memorial to Emperor Taizong.

description.zh: 644 年秋，玄奘自于阗东行，沿塔里木盆地南缘经若羌抵达沙州。他在此再次上表，报告携经归国。太宗得表后敕令敦煌官吏于流沙迎接，并命沿途州县供给。
description.en: In autumn 644 Xuanzang came east from Khotan along the southern Tarim route to Shazhou, where he sent another memorial announcing his return with the scriptures. Taizong ordered officials to meet him at the edge of the desert and supply him along the road.

place.zh: 凉州（今甘肃武威）

summary.zh: 玄奘自敦煌东行，经河西走廊州县迎送。
summary.en: Xuanzang travels east through the Hexi Corridor, escorted by the prefectures.

description.zh: 玄奘自沙州东行，经瓜州、肃州、甘州、凉州、兰州、秦州，沿途州县承太宗敕令供给人力鞍乘。岁末抵关内，次年正月二十四日入长安。
description.en: From Shazhou Xuanzang travelled east through Guazhou, Suzhou, Ganzhou, Liangzhou, Lanzhou and Qinzhou, supplied by the prefectures under Taizong’s order, reaching Chang’an on the twenty-fourth day of the first month of 645.

place.zh: 长安

summary.zh: 玄奘回到长安，带回大量佛经。
summary.en: Xuanzang returns to Chang’an with a large collection of Buddhist scriptures.

description.zh: 645 年，玄奘回到长安，受到盛大欢迎，随后主持译经。
description.en: In 645, Xuanzang returned to Chang’an to a grand welcome and later led the translation of Buddhist texts.
